angularCompilerOptions.__comment: Copy this block from the app tsconfig (tsconfig.app.json, which some repos keep under src/) so specs compile under the same strictness as the app; if the app tsconfig has no angularCompilerOptions, delete this whole block. Keep `files` in NgModule apps: the compiler needs the declaring NgModule in the program, or every `standalone: false` component fails with NG8001. Standalone apps (vm.ui, console.ui) delete `files`. Delete this key.
